description: Maintained electronic-invoice fixture corpus. Every fixture is authored by PXA from the public structure of the standards, so all of it is redistributable with this repository. No third-party or customer document is included: official FeRD/FNFE and KoSIT artifacts and any real invoice stay out until their redistribution terms have been reviewed (EINV-01), which is why no fixture here claims official conformance.

provenanceKinds.pxa-authored: Written for this repository from the published structure of the standard. PXA holds the copyright and may redistribute it.
provenanceKinds.official-licensed: An official artifact whose redistribution terms have been reviewed and recorded. None present yet.

expectedResults.recognized: Secure structural recognition succeeds: the syntax is CII or UBL and a guideline or customization identifier is present. Never a conformance claim.
expectedResults.recognizedWithWarnings: Recognition succeeds and PXA reports non-blocking business warnings.
expectedResults.rejected: Recognition fails closed with the listed error diagnostics.
